messages.text: Wave 2: retail first or finance first? I check the 24 drafts by 11 either way.
The Halden offer is drafted from the template. Mara, it needs your OK.
Retail first. Send wave 2 to the retail brands first.

readBack.quote: Retail first, 20 a day from 11:00, after Lea's check.

messages.text: Call prep, what do I need to know for Brightmoor at 15:00?
Brightmoor sells to 9,000 small retailers. Their head of partnerships joined in May from a bank and launched two referral programmes there. The full brief is ready at 13:00.
